scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @duel/client" "npm run dev -w @duel/server"
scripts.build: npm run test -w @duel/game-core && npm run build -w @duel/client && npm run build -w @duel/server
scripts.deploy:client: npm run build -w @duel/client && firebase deploy --only hosting
